faqs.question: How can I take admission?
faqs.answer: You can visit any Shital Academy branch or contact the academy directly to complete the admission process.
follow_up: Which course are you interested in?

faqs.question: Can you help me choose the right course?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our counselors help students choose the most suitable course according to their education, interests and career goals.
follow_up: What is your education level and career goal? (For example: MIS, accounting, back office, programming, data analytics, or English speaking.)

faqs.question: What documents are required for admission?
faqs.answer: Please contact the academy for the course-specific admission requirements and documents required for admission.

faqs.question: Who can join Shital Academy?
faqs.answer: Eligibility depends on the selected course.
follow_up: Which course are you interested in?

faqs.question: Is there any age limit?
faqs.answer: There is no age limit. Anyone can join Shital Academy courses.

faqs.question: Are admissions open?
faqs.answer: Yes, Admissions are open. It depend on course and batch availability.

faqs.question: Can I join anytime?
faqs.answer: Joining depends on the availability of batches.

faqs.question: Do you provide demo classes?
faqs.answer: Yes, demo classes are available for selected courses so students can understand the teaching method, course content, and learning environment before taking admission.

faqs.question: How do I register?
faqs.answer: You can register by visiting the academy or contacting the academy directly.

faqs.question: How can I know the course fees?
faqs.answer: Course fees vary depending on the selected course.Our fess range from 6,500 to 25,000.
follow_up: Which course are you asking about?

faqs.question: Can I pay fees in installments?
faqs.answer: Yes, installment facilities are available for selected courses. The installment structure may vary depending on the course and fee amount. Please contact the academy for details.

faqs.question: Which payment methods are accepted?
faqs.answer: Please contact the academy for the currently accepted payment methods.

faqs.question: Do you offer discounts?
faqs.answer: Discounts are very limited and are offered only on special festivals or occasions. Please contact the academy for the latest offers and eligibility.

faqs.question: Is the course fee refundable?
faqs.answer: No refund policy: once payment is made, it cannot be refunded.

faqs.question: Will I receive a fee receipt?
faqs.answer: Yes. Students can obtain a payment receipt after successful fee payment.

faqs.question: What are the batch timings?
faqs.answer: Yes. Flexible batch timings are available from 7:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m.
follow_up: Which course are you interested in?

faqs.question: Do you have weekend batches?
faqs.answer: Weekend batches may be available depending on the course and branch. Please contact the academy for the current schedule.

faqs.question: Are online classes available?
faqs.answer: Online batches may be available depending on the preferred course. Please contact the academy to check current online-batch availability.

faqs.question: Are offline classes available?
faqs.answer: Yes. Most courses are conducted through offline classroom training.

faqs.question: Can I change my batch later?
faqs.answer: Batch changes depend on seat availability and academy policy.

faqs.question: What happens if I miss a class?
faqs.answer: If you miss a class, please discuss it with your faculty or branch to know whether backup or other options are available for your course.

faqs.question: Are your faculty members experienced?
faqs.answer: Yes. Shital Academy has qualified, experienced, patient and supportive faculty members.

faqs.question: Do students receive individual attention?
faqs.answer: Yes. The academy follows a personalized teaching approach with individual attention for every student.

faqs.question: Do you provide study material?
faqs.answer: Yes. Comprehensive study material is provided according to the requirements of the selected course.

faqs.question: Do courses include practical training?
faqs.answer: Yes. Most technical and professional courses focus on practical learning along with theory.

faqs.question: Will I receive a certificate after completing the course?
faqs.answer: Yes. Students receive a certificate after successfully completing the course.
follow_up: Which course are you asking about?

faqs.question: Do you provide placement support?
faqs.answer: Yes, placement support is available for the Diploma in Office Executive course and IT courses. The level of placement assistance may vary depending on the course.
follow_up: Which course are you interested in?

faqs.question: Do you provide internships?
faqs.answer: Internship opportunities vary depending on the course. Please contact the academy for current availability.

faqs.question: What is Shital Academy?
faqs.answer: Shital Academy is a training institute that offers career-oriented courses with practical learning, experienced faculty and personalized guidance.

faqs.question: Why should I choose Shital Academy?
keywords: why should i join shital academy
faqs.answer: Shital Academy focuses on practical learning, experienced faculty, flexible batches, personalized guidance and career-oriented training.

faqs.question: How can I contact Shital Academy?
faqs.answer: You can contact Shital Academy using the phone numbers, email address, or by visiting your nearest branch.

faqs.question: Where are your branches located?
faqs.answer: Shital Academy has multiple branches. Please check the branch information or contact the academy to find the nearest branch.

faqs.question: Is parking available?
faqs.answer: Parking availability may vary by branch. Please contact your preferred branch for details.

faqs.question: Do you have computer labs?
faqs.answer: Computer-related courses include practical learning using the academy's lab facilities.

faqs.question: Is attendance compulsory?
faqs.answer: Attendance requirements may differ depending on the course.

faqs.question: Are classes conducted on public holidays?
faqs.answer: Class schedules during holidays may vary.

faqs.question: Can I take leave during the course?
faqs.answer: If you need leave, please inform your faculty or branch in advance whenever possible.

faqs.question: In which language are classes conducted?
faqs.answer: The language of instruction may vary depending on the course and faculty.

faqs.question: Are your courses suitable for beginners?
faqs.answer: Yes. Many courses are designed specifically for beginners and are taught step by step.

faqs.question: Can working professionals join?
faqs.answer: Yes. Flexible batch timings are available for many courses to suit students and working professionals.

faqs.question: How long does a course take to complete?
faqs.answer: Course duration varies depending on the selected course.
follow_up: Which course are you asking about?

faqs.question: Are all courses offline?
faqs.answer: Most courses are offered through offline classroom training.

faqs.question: Do students receive support during the course?
faqs.answer: Yes. Faculty members provide guidance and support throughout the learning process.

faqs.question: Can I ask doubts during the course?
faqs.answer: Yes. Students are encouraged to ask questions, and faculty members provide doubt-solving support.

faqs.question: What services does Shital Academy provide?
faqs.answer: Shital Academy offers career-oriented training programs, practical learning, experienced faculty, flexible batches, and personalized guidance across multiple courses.

faqs.question: Do I need to bring my own laptop?
faqs.answer: I don't have confirmed information about laptop requirements yet. Please contact the academy to check whether a laptop is required for your selected course.

faqs.answer: Branch 2 is in Vitthalwadi: 2nd Floor, Hardik Complex, Besides Suraj Sofa, Vitthalwadi, Bhavnagar.
